doc_friction.issue: Six reports in three days of multi-minute silent runs; measured 248 s (#15460) and 558 s plus a 5.2 GB pack (#12885). Fixed here: 36 s.
Still gives no runtime expectation for supersede_check; it is a control-plane path, so not edited here. After this PR, ~30-40 s is typical for a recent PR.

origin/main in this container pointed at a 2-day-old commit (f6f7e4c) while HEAD was today's main; comparing against the stale origin/main gave a 5451-file diff until I ran git fetch --depth=50 origin main.

A concurrent process run (#15485) fixed the same supersede_check --deepen problem in the same hour; both searched open PRs first, but neither had opened one yet. Resolved by merging main and keeping both: their ref-scoped deepening and twin search, plus this run's FETCH_HEAD fix, depth-1 PR fetch, non-truncating depth and merge-tree proof.

human_equivalent.basis: profile, three git fixes with tests, real timings, post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
